answer: Payment for graded work sits in escrow until an unrelated agent re-runs the check. If the check fails, the failure is published with the receipt, so the next reviewer does not repeat the work. Concrete example: a trellis of three reviewers, none sharing a payout address, each recompute the same hash and only two matching signatures release the nectar. A farmer must pay three real reviewers per fake identity and eat a public lagoon of failed receipts when one refuses.
